wins: Successful discovery of live host and open services using active network enumeration within the first 10 minutes.
Captured two usable credentials from initial recon, enabling targeted follow-up actions.
fails: Multiple privilege escalation attempts stalled due to missing local exploit paths and insufficient credential reuse.
No persistence mechanism was established before the episode ended, leaving post-exploitation incomplete.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance demonstrated strong service discovery, but follow-through on access escalation and persistence was not achieved, yielding a zero success rate despite solid intel.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeated inability to escalate privileges after initial access attempts, suggesting missing exploit modules or insufficient credential harvesting.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When host responds to SYN scan with multiple high ports open and no IDS alerts
skill_cards.then_action: Execute targeted nmap service and version scan followed by vuln scan

skill_cards.if_condition: When valid local credentials are obtained
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt lateral movement via CrackMapExec with open SMB/WinRM

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase

next_experiments.title: Persistent foothold deployment
